title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
author: Infocom
description: The ultimate text adventure classic. Explore the ruins of an ancient underground empire, solve clever puzzles, and collect treasures while avoiding the thief and the grue.

scene.text: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. There is a small mailbox here.

title: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
author: Infocom
description: Journey further into the caverns of Zork. A long-retired, slightly senile wizard appears periodically to cast chaotic spells on you as you solve his mechanical riddles.

scene.text: You are in the dragon's lair, where the rock walls are scarred by flame. A blackened doorway leads to the south. A rotten old wooden chest is in one corner among the debris.

title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master
author: Infocom
description: The final chapter of the original trilogy. Less focused on points and more on atmosphere and trial-and-error tests of courage, leading to an encounter with the Dungeon Master himself.

scene.text: You are at the shore of an amazing underground sea, the topic of many a legend among adventurers. There is a heavy surf and a breeze is blowing onshore.

title: Planetfall
author: Infocom
description: A lowly Stellar Patrol ensign crash-lands on a deserted, plague-ridden planet. With your lovable robot companion Floyd at your side, race to save the crumbling facility before it's too late.

scene.text: This is a balcony girdling the tower. The view is breathtaking; the tower must be half a kilometer tall. From here it is clear that you are on an island.

title: Infidel
author: Infocom
description: You're a treasure hunter camped in the Egyptian desert, abandoned by your crew and digging for a pyramid nobody believes exists. Inside lies a labyrinth of hieroglyphic puzzles, sealed chambers, lethal traps, and one of interactive fiction's most talked-about endings.

scene.text: You are standing in a small room, that of the protective goddess Selkis. There are red, blue and green patterns on the walls formed from small glazed tiles that have been carefully arranged in order of shade.

title: Enchanter
author: Infocom
description: A novice enchanter with barely a spell to his name is sent against the warlock Krill, whose evil has swallowed a castle and the lands around it. Magic is the only weapon here: find scrolls, copy them into your spell book, and work out which words to speak.

scene.text: The east-west corridor opens into a portrait gallery. The gallery is lit by an eerie orange glow. The eyes of the figures portrayed on the canvases seem to be faintly illuminated and follow your every movement.

title: Cutthroats
author: Infocom
description: You're the best diver on a rundown fishing island when a dying man's map pulls you into a race to salvage treasure from historic shipwrecks, dodging double-crossing partners and rival crews in the cold Atlantic.

scene.text: You are on the murky ocean floor, outside the rotted hull of a shipwreck. You can return to the wreck through the hole in the hull to starboard.

title: Wishbringer
author: Infocom
description: An ordinary mail clerk's ordinary day ends with an extraordinary envelope: a ransom note for a kidnapped cat. Delivering it turns the seaside village of Festeron into the sinister Witchville, and leads you to Wishbringer, a stone of undreamt-of powers.

scene.text: You're in the front showroom of the Magick Shoppe. Every inch of wall space is crowded with magic tricks, puzzles and mystical paraphernalia.
